title: Trunk muscle EMG during upright isometric flexion vs extension exertions against horizontal T10 loads

quantity.name: EMG amplitude
quantity.definition: normalised EMG during steady-state isometric exertion, mean over subjects pooled over the three load levels (SD not reported)

source.authors: Granata KP, Lee PE, Franklin TC
source.sample: 14 healthy subjects (7 M, 7 F), no history of LBD

protocol.summary: Upright standing, pelvis and lower body restrained in a frame; chest harness + cable applying horizontal isotonic force of 100, 135 or 170 N at T10. Load attached anteriorly -> isometric extension effort; posteriorly -> flexion effort. Measured L5/S1 moments (inverse dynamics, Table 2): flexion 57.3 ± 4.3, 68.9 ± 5.2, 82.3 ± 9.5 Nm; extension 55.1 ± 5.4, 70.9 ± 6.3, 79.2 ± 9.1 Nm at 100/135/170 N. EMG: bipolar surface electrodes, left and right RA, LP, IO, EO (sites per Marras & Mirka 1992, see data 'site'); rectified, 5 Hz low-pass. Normalisation: %MVC, max during isometric MVCs in flexion, extension, right and left lateral bending/twist exertions (McGill 1991).
how_to_simulate: Scale model to the male (180.3 cm, 74.9 kg) and female (166.2 cm, 64.3 kg) means; upright standing, pelvis fixed
Apply a horizontal force of 100, 135 and 170 N at T10, directed posteriorly (flexion exertion) or anteriorly (extension exertion); check net L5/S1 moment ~55-82 Nm (Table 2)

Average activations over the three load levels and compare RA, IO, EO and erector spinae at L3 (4 cm lateral) with measured %MVC; key qualitative target: substantial LP co-activation (12.5 %MVC) during flexion exertions

subject_model.sex: mixed (7 M, 7 F); simulate male 180.3 cm / 74.9 kg and female 166.2 cm / 64.3 kg separately or a 173 cm / 69.6 kg average

protocol.notes: EMG values given only as means pooled over load levels (no SD, no per-level values). Co-contraction % and compression (Table 2, Fig. 2-3) are EMG-assisted model outputs - not extracted as measured tests. Text gives trunk moment 59.3 (6.8) Nm at 100 N, which disagrees with the Table 2 values (57.3/55.1, mean 56.2); Table 2 used here. DOI not printed in the NIH manuscript; likely 10.1016/j.clinbiomech.2005.07.006 (unverified).

extraction.check_notes: Re-read: RA 15.3 vs 10.5; IO 10.4 (flex) vs 7.5 (ext); EO 9.3 vs 5.3; LP 12.5 (flex) vs 15.2 (ext). Table 2 means reproduce text flexion 69.5 / extension 68.4 Nm.
